title: RACING LEAGUE OVERVIEW! Copi Cafe Episode 59 | Cornucopias
description:
Join Co-CEOs Rob Greig and Josh Jones in episode 59 of Copi Cafe as they discuss the breaking XRP news that emerged during their recording. Transitioning from there,  they conduct a retrospective of the recently concluded Valley Raceworx T3 Mint, while also exploring the highly anticipated release schedule of the game and upcoming Racing League.

Next, they dive into the collection of the OG Survey; a crucial step leading up to the upcoming launch of the first testing phase of the game. 

Stay tuned as they address community questions and jump into some serious leaks. Don't miss the fascinating Aerial Track view showcased in the leaks!

Wrapping up the show, they provide additional details and insights regarding the Vehicle Scrapyard.

00:00 Beverage Choices
02:19 XRP vs SEC
07:08 T3 Mint Review
12:17 Release Schedule
14:17 Racing League
19:28 OG Survey
21:29 Community Questions
29:51 LEAKS
32:39 Yellow Track Aerial View LEAK
33:27 Vehicle Scrapyard

Cornucopias is an MMORPG Metaverse game accessible through multiple platforms and created on Unreal Engine 5. 
The vision is to bring freedom, power, autonomy and new economics to the player. 
Our ambition is to create a cutting-edge metaverse experience through immersive gameplay, an exciting story, exceptional artwork and innovative economics.

The Cornucopias Metaverse is a network of floating bubbles and domes, each with diverse themes and characteristics. Here, players of all ages can engage in a series of mini-games and explore vast landscapes in search of precious resources which can be crafted into valuable items.
